# Test fixtures

`class-roster.json` is a **fictional** 120-student class list used by the tests in place of a signed-in roster. It has
the same shape as the roster the tests were written for (five classes, the same team sizes, IDs such as
`5-A:gryffindor:0`, two students who share a name in different classes, abbreviations and Turkish letters), but every
name is invented. Real student names are never stored in this repository: the real class lists live only in the
teacher's Google Sheet (Roster tab).
